description: Delete a customer: pass customer_id. This removes the record, and it cannot be undone by another tool, so check it is the right one with get_customer first. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
